information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE3OTcxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8153fc30cdcdfbddd9aedbc2a70f0251c74a9ebd/1001187928.jpg) NEOSS (New Era Of Surabaya Speedcubing) mempersembahkan **Grand Premiere Surabaya 2026** yang merupakan kompetisi speedcubing resmi yang diadakan selama 2 hari dengan 3x3x3 sebagai cabang utama. Kompetisi ini akan berlangsung di Pakuwon Mall Surabaya, mall terbesar di Indonesia. Kompetisi ini terbuka untuk semua warga negara. Registrasi dapat dilakukan pada laman [Daftar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GrandPremiereSurabaya2026/register). Pastikan Anda melampirkan bukti transfer pada [Formulir Ini](https://forms.gle/FAquWjPABNBcbXzW9) Kami tidak akan menerima pendaftaran Anda jika Anda belum melakukan konfirmasi kepada kami. Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, silakan menghubungi kontak yang tersedia ----------- NEOSS (New Era Of Surabaya Speedcubing) proudly presents **Grand Premiere Surabaya 2026** speedcubing competition which will be held for 2 days with 3x3x3 as the main event. The competition will be held at Pakuwon Mall Surabaya, the largest shopping mall in Indonesia. This competition is open to all nationality. Registration can be done on the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GrandPremiereSurabaya2026/register) page. Make sure you submit your proof of transfer on [This Form](https://forms.gle/FAquWjPABNBcbXzW9) We will not accept your registration if you have not confirmed it with us. For further information, please contact the contact provided ----------- Important In accordance with articles 2g, 2k, and 2l, competitors that fail to abide by the specified WCA Regulations shall be disqualified, at the discretion of the WCA delegate.
